review:
Xmas Drop is Hacksaw's festive expanding-wild slot. Wild Santa symbols expand downwards when they're part of a winning combination, counting as wild on every position they cover, and each reel can hold only one Wild Santa.

When an expanding Wild Santa passes through a Wild Gift symbol, it turns into a multiplier worth 2x to 200x. If several expanded Santas with multipliers form a win, their values are added. Three FS scatters award 10 free spins in the Night Before Christmas bonus, with better odds of Santas and gifts, and three more scatters add four spins. Hacksaw rates it 3 out of 5 with a 12,500x maximum and a top RTP of 96.22%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
